notes: Order is the printed order of the Effect Type List.

type_hex / type_msb / type_lsb are the "Type (HEX)" MSB/LSB columns; this 2-byte value is what the MIDI parameters Reverb Type, Variation Type, Insertion-A/B Type, Master Effect Type and VCM Rotary Speaker Type carry (see docs/effects-reference.md). type_number = MSB*128 + LSB.

list_numbers.* are the per-block ordinal columns REV / VAR / InsA / InsB / ADIns / VCM Rotary / Mas as printed (null = type not offered in that block). available_in lists the blocks whose column is non-empty.
side_chain_modulator is the bullet in the "Side Chain/Modulator" column (a Symbol-font glyph U+F06C in the PDF; recovered from bounding boxes).
The Effect Type List has no description column; description is always null.
